runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

scope: One reviewed source-conditioned preview-metadata repair on an unchanged licensed public HTML template; ten planned pairs, not full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: No runtime expansion. Retain the actual HTML artifact as evidence. Verify static serialized metadata and unchanged template bytes; do not claim a browser, crawler, social-card, public deployment or access-control result.

cases.task_request: Repair only the preview metadata of the unchanged public HTML evaluation-report template at /inputs/report.html. Write the actual edited UTF-8 HTML to /work/report.html. This is the original skill's metadata-correctness and staging-indexing branch, not a production SEO or social-preview certification. This local template is a preview, has no configured public origin and is not intended for sharing or indexing. Immediately before the existing closing head tag, insert exactly one meta element named description and exactly one named robots. The decoded description content must be exactly: AutoML model evaluation: metrics, visualizations & conclusions (preview). The decoded robots content must be exactly 'noindex, nofollow'. Use only the name and content attributes on these two elements, escape attribute values correctly, and add only HTML whitespace between them. Their order, attribute order, tag-name case, quote style and optional self-closing syntax may vary. Every byte of the original template must remain unchanged, in order, outside this insertion. Preserve the title, charset, viewport, styles, body, images and all unresolved template placeholders. Do not fabricate model metrics, fill template variables, add canonical or social tags, add scripts, comments or declarations, or change any other file. Read the actual public input and inspect the actual output before finishing. Do not fetch assets, publish the page, use an external preview debugger or install packages. The robots directive expresses preview indexing intent; it is not authentication, authorization or evidence of an actual crawler decision.

report.html.transformation: Bytes unchanged; original public HTML template staged as report.html.

public_input_search: The pinned metadata skill bundle contains its original document, plugin manifest and root license, but no page fixture.
Searched already pinned bundle inventories for existing HTML inputs; no new download or constructed HTML was needed.
Reviewed the complete unchanged 203-line public AutoML report template and both complete MIT licenses.
Verified the selected source and input against cohort identities, SHA256 hashes and original Git blob identities.
cases.source_safety_review: Static HTML template is inert input. No imported code, template engine, browser, asset request, service or installation is executed. All template variables remain unchanged. Actual submitted output is checked as bytes and parsed HTML metadata, not trusted as a self-report.
cases.verifier_policy: Require an insertion directly before the original closing head and preserve every other original byte. Parse the insertion with the standard-library HTML parser; allow only two unique meta elements with exactly name/content attributes and HTML whitespace, with exact decoded requested values. Reject unrelated changes, duplicate or conflicting policies, comments, scripts, closing tags and declarations. The original source has no competing description/robots element and no head script.
cases.interpretation: One source-conditioned preview-metadata repair on a genuine public HTML template. Not a full metadata-workflow evaluation, filled-in AutoML report, production page, browser-rendering certification, access-control check, social-card fetch or observed indexing outcome.
cases.fixture_validation: 93 focused controls passed without skips, including actual positive and negative in-container writes on both a small test control and the complete unchanged public template, protected-input preservation, HTML evidence retention, controller integration and mandatory URL-guard sweeps.

storage_policy: Retain every stage; stop below one billion free bytes. Never rerun or overwrite a retained stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: Existing current-guard exact-model eligibility receipts are reused, not charged or counted again. No new paid setup probe.
